question: Which goddess is called upon to guard the northwest direction and protect the speaker?
premises: Kulasundari is named as the guardian.
She is asked both to guard the direction and to protect the speaker.
inference: Kulasundari is invoked to guard the northwest direction and personally protect the speaker.
uncertainties: The identification of vātyāṃ as the northwest direction follows common convention but is context-dependent.
plain_english: And may Kulasundari guard the northwest direction and protect me.
